quarterly_data.quarter: Accelink press release: Accelink's Domestic Debut at CIOE 2026: 800G L Band OSFP (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Accelink says it has launched an 800G L Band OSFP ZR/ZR+ pluggable coherent module, debuted in China with a live demo at CIOE 2026. It uses Accelink's self-developed L-Band optical devices (the company says it designs and manufactures the chain from the coherent optical engine to key optical components in-house) and achieves L-Band output power better than 0 dBm in a compact OSFP package; the company says the module has stable mass-production capability. Used in parallel with C-band, it supports single-fiber capacity doubling from 25.6T to 51.2T without new fiber, and complies with OIF 800ZR, OpenZR+ and OpenROADM. Target uses: cloud data center DCI, metro backbone and campus computing networks. No customers, volumes or availability date stated.
